parameters.content:
## Discord Mass Role Assignment

### Flow
```
[Trigger every 5 min]
 → Read Config        (checkpoint from Config tab)
 → Read User Batch    (next 250 rows from Users tab)
 → Normalize IDs      (extract user_id from each row)
 → Loop Over Items    (10 users per cycle)
     → Assign Role    (Discord, continues past errors)
     → Throttle 6s    (stay under Discord rate limits)
 → Compute Summary    (counts + failed users)
 → Advance Checkpoint (1 Sheets write)
 → Append Run Log     (1 Sheets write)
 → Append Failures    (1 Sheets write, only if any failed)
```

### Resume logic
`checkpoint` in the Config tab = number of Users rows
already processed. Every run reads the next 250 rows from
that offset and advances the checkpoint once at the end.
When no rows are left, the run stops after Read User Batch
and nothing else executes — deactivate the workflow then.

Role-adds are idempotent: re-assigning a role a user
already has is harmless, so a crashed run simply redoes
at most one 250-row batch on the next tick.

### Why the range starts one row early
The Sheets node treats the first row of an explicit A1
range as the column header. The range therefore starts at
checkpoint+1: on the first batch that row is the real
header, afterwards it is the last already-processed user.
Normalize IDs reads the single cell positionally, so the
varying header name does not matter.

### Setup (see README for detail)
- [ ] Replace YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID on all 5 Sheets nodes
- [ ] Set Google Sheets credential on those 5 nodes
- [ ] Set Discord Bot credential on Assign Role
- [ ] Open Assign Role → pick Server + Role from dropdowns
- [ ] Users tab column formatted as PLAIN TEXT (critical —
      Sheets corrupts 18-digit IDs stored as numbers)
- [ ] checkpoint = 0 in Config tab, then activate

### Sheets writes per run: ≤3 (quota-safe)
### Throughput: 250 users / 5 min ≈ 72k/day ≈ 8 days for 570k
Tune up only if the Failures tab stays free of 429 errors.

nodes.name: Read Config
nodes.notes: Config tab has two columns (name, value) and one data row: checkpoint | 0

nodes.name: Read User Batch
nodes.notes: Reads 251 rows: 1 header/overlap row + up to 250 users. The range starts one row EARLY on purpose — the Sheets node consumes the first row of an explicit range as the column header. That row is either the real header (first batch) or a user that was already processed. When 0 data rows come back, the workflow stops here.

nodes.name: Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: 10 users per cycle, followed by a 6-second Throttle → sustained pace of roughly 1.1 requests/second, just under Discord's observed ~10-per-10s bucket for the add-role route.

nodes.name: Assign Role
nodes.notes: Open this node once after import: pick your Server and the Role from the dropdowns (they load from your bot credential). User ID comes from the sheet via expression. onError = continue: users who left the server, malformed IDs etc. flow through with an error field and are written to the Failures tab — they never stop the run.

nodes.name: Throttle
nodes.notes: 6s pause after every 10 users. Lower this only if the Failures tab stays free of 429 / rate-limit errors.

nodes.name: Advance Checkpoint
nodes.notes: ONE Sheets write per 250-user batch. Matches the Config row where name = checkpoint.

nodes.name: Append Run Log
nodes.notes: One heartbeat row per run — watch this tab to confirm the workflow is alive and progressing. When rows stop appearing, the list is finished.

nodes.name: Append Failures
nodes.notes: All failed rows of a batch are appended in one API call. 429 / rate-limit errors here mean you tuned the throttle too aggressively — those users are safe to re-run.
